item.title: Water interruptions to hit Metro Manila, Rizal, Cainta due to maintenance, high demand
item.description: MANILA, Philippines -- Parts of Metro Manila, Rizal and Cavite will have scheduled water interruptions this week because of maintenance works and high demand, the two water concessionaires said on Sunday. item.title: Legarda’s Veterans Month Act targets institutional reform, national consciousness
item.description: SENATOR Loren Legarda sponsored Senate Bill No. 1719, declaring April of every year as Philippine Veterans Month while establishing a permanent national framework to honor Filipino veterans and ensure sustained access to services and education.
